partner: config/partner.json (brand, reseller, payment_url; copied into config/trial.json at birth)

trial_record.missing_operator_copy: fails closed on a trial civ

convert: python3 tools/apply_trial_profile.py convert [--operator-copy PATH] [--restore-models]  (default: the recorded operator copy)

seams.M3_ROUTER_BASE_URL: REQUIRED. Anthropic-wire-compatible base URL of the M3 router for this tenant. Filled at provisioning; never committed.
seams.M3_ROUTER_KEY_FILE: REQUIRED (or M3_ROUTER_KEY). This tenant's per-actor router key. Copied to config/lifeboat/router_key.txt mode 0600; never echoed.
seams.TRIAL_PAYMENT_URL: optional override; default payment_url from config/partner.json. apply refuses if neither is an https URL
seams.TRIAL_OPERATOR_COPY: REQUIRED in production: /etc/aiciv/trial.json (outside the civ tree; root-owned when apply runs as root). Recorded as TRIAL_CONFIG_PATH in .claude/settings.json env.
